message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage. I was cozy on the couch, reading, when suddenly everything went dark. My husband looked at me with that familiar smirk, and I couldn’t help but smile back. You see, I had insisted we stock up on flashlights, portable chargers, and a trusty lantern—just in case. 

As I fumbled for the flashlight, I felt a little smug knowing we were ready while the neighbors were scrambling around. It reminded me that a little preparation goes a long way; it’s always nice to have a few backup plans in your pocket. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during a blackout?
